courses.note: Required algorithms course (Data Structures and Algorithms; the major requires no separate algorithms course). Syllabus is a Google Doc linked from a public course GitHub repository whose landing page is labeled Spring 2024; the doc itself is headed Fall 2026. The Spring 2024 course site (https://colgateuniversitycomputerscience.github.io/cosc202/) links syllabi only through shortened URLs that returned 403, so was not collected. Landing page saved as v2c-colgate-C3.

The major (COSC 101/102/202/208/290 plus four electives) requires neither a software engineering course nor a capstone. Honors students complete COSC 492, an independent project, which is not required of all majors.
